name: NetworkCapacityPlanningBoard
tagline: See which links and cells run out of headroom before an upgrade can land – and plan the capex to fix it.
description: A complete telecom capacity planning app in one Power Apps code component: busy-hour utilisation register for backhaul, RAN, fibre access, aggregation, core and peering; compound growth forecast with trigger, exhaustion and order-by dates; scenario heat map; upgrade project board from proposal to ready-for-service; quarterly capex plan against budget.
features: Compound growth forecast with trigger, exhaustion and order-by dates
Growth scenarios (-25% to +100%) and planned upgrades in the forecast
Risk classification: Congested, Breached, Order now, Watch, Mitigated, Healthy
Project lifecycle rules with drag and drop and keyboard Move menu
Completion adds capacity and rescales utilisation
Bulk raise, planner and trigger; CSV export; undo
controlType: standard (data-set control + Power Pages field control)
